change: CRITICAL FIX: End-of-Day Balance reasons (e.g. 'Work done, driver not around') were silently dropped from Daily Report / Download for Boss / Combined Report whenever the truck had no OTHER job card or gate activity logged that same day -- e.g. a truck sitting for several days awaiting the driver. The code only attached the reason if a row already existed for that truck; now it creates a row from the truck's active entry (or the balance note alone) so the reason is never lost. Affects the on-screen Daily Report, the XLSX download, and the Combined Report sheet -- all three share this same underlying data.
